intro.title: Grounding in the Present
intro.question: What do you feel right now, in this moment?
description: When waves of anxiety rise high, the fierce spray can cloud our vision, causing us to lose sight of this very moment.
We can't stop the waves, but we can pay attention to each sensation we feel right now.
Instead of thoughts, try focusing on the sights and sounds around you.
This will help you find your center even amidst the highest waves.
intro.contentDescription: A practice of awakening your senses to find the 'here and now' amidst surging waves.
steps: 3. Focus on 3 things you can hear
intro.tip: Tip: Without judging, slowly focus on each sensation just as it is.

step2.subject: 4 things you can touch
step2.example: The firmness of a chair, the texture of clothes, etc.

step3.subject: 3 things you can hear
step3.example: Distant noise, the ticking of a clock, etc.

step5.subject: 1 thing you can taste
step5.example: The feeling in your mouth, or the aftertaste of water

step.hint: * Tap the button once you've found each sensation

result.title: You are here in this moment
description: Even amidst high waves, you awakened your senses and clearly faced the 'here and now.'
The waves are still rolling, but you are now standing firm, no longer swept away.
Is your vision a little clearer now? It's time to take a closer look at the waves rippling across your ocean.
In the next step, 'Recording Today's Waves,' discover the true emotions stirring within you.

history.completed: Even amidst rough waves, you held on to the sensations of this moment.
